summary: Ashland Inc. filed an 8-K on July 27, 2026, announcing the appointment of Peter Thomas and Allen Spizzo as independent directors, effective immediately, expanding the board to eleven members, with a planned reduction to ten before the 2027 annual meeting. The new directors bring significant specialty chemicals and financial expertise, including prior roles at Ferro Corporation, Berry Global, and Hercules Incorporated. The appointments appear routine and not forced or abrupt, but the filing includes director departure details per Item 5.02. No activist campaign or strategic review is disclosed. Watch for any further board changes or strategic shifts, though no immediate risk-arb angle exists.
